Notes
-----
Proposals 6, 7 and 9 have no <id>.dao.wei name, so the DAO's own on-chain page
(dao.wei.limo) renders their description cell empty. The text itself is not lost:
it is a non-indexed arg of ProposalCreated, which is why wei.domains/dao.html
shows all nine. This backfills the on-chain page to match.

Cause: propose() mints the name inside `try this.nameProposal(...) {} catch {}`.
Because the failure is swallowed, eth_estimateGas converges on a limit where the
naming runs out of gas while the transaction still succeeds. Measured on a fork:
the estimator returned 149,892 and produced 1 log; 1,500,000 produced 9 logs and
used 470,478. wei.domains/dao.html now floors propose gas at 700,000.

Each payload is `rescue(DAO, 0, nameProposal(id, target, value, description))`,
sent to the DAO from the exec.dao.wei holder (0x006CD14F36F65eCbB29b2519cCBe63A0DC8549F2).
nameProposal only accepts calls from the DAO itself, so rescue is the way in.

Rehearsed on a mainnet fork at block 26057536: all three succeed (~384k gas each),
every name mints to the DAO with its description, target and value records, and
html() then renders 9 of 9 descriptions with none empty. The proposals themselves
are untouched — #6 stays vetoed, #7 and #9 stay open with their values unchanged.
The descriptions below are copied verbatim from each ProposalCreated log.
